title: Pattern Dump
description: How Pattern Dump turns components and markdown pages into a checked website.
body:
01 · The problem

Design systems and websites drift apart

The page's slides follow the cover, each one a slide component.

02 · The reveal

Each card comes out of the paper

03 · The end

The last card stays out

Scroll back to play it all in reverse.
